parole.testo: Origin disputed. * Compare Aromanian mãndzu, Megleno-Romanian mǫndz; possibly from or related and cognate to Albanian (Gheg) mâz (compare standard mëz and Old Albanian manz) through the substratum, or of Illyrian origin. * Compare the Thracian word mezenai (“horse”) and Messapic Menzana, a horse dei
